vot_greeter: My name's Nakhtar. This is the Valley of Trials, where the Horde trains its recruits, and lately it's where people like you wake up as well. I'll tell you when you're ready for Durotar. Until then, I've got work for you.
vot_guard_1: I keep the camp road. The boars are west of here and the scorpids are north-east, and past the scorpids there's a cave full of demons that I've not got the soldiers to clear. If you want something to fight, I can tell you where.
vot_elder: I've been teaching recruits in this valley longer than Nakhtar's been talking to them. He'll tell you about the Horde. I'll send you into the Den and out to the dunes, and you'll learn more that way.
vot_recruit_watcher: I've been watching the tracks on this ridge for six seasons. The boars stay on Sagebrush Flat, west of camp, except for one big one that keeps walking through the training dummies.
vot_goblin_tinkerer: I'm Fizzcrank, and I'm doing research here until the camp asks me to leave. Please don't touch the bench, it isn't finished and part of it might be on fire.
vot_orc_mother: My son's one of the recruits. He went up the ridge last week and came back, and I'd like it to stay that way. I'm a weaver. If you're going into the Den, come and talk to me first.
vot_wounded_grunt: A scorpid opened up my leg at the nest before I killed it. Nakhtar says I'll walk again. Until then I'm stuck sitting here, and the vultures have started taking an interest.
vot_skeleton_curiosity: [A skeleton, upright, at the edge of camp. It does not move and it does not speak. Nobody here put it there, and nobody has been willing to be the one who takes it down.]
vot_young_orc: I've killed more boars on this ridge than anyone my age, and I'm not leaving the valley until I've got something better than a boar to show for it.
ct_vot: I train every kind of fighter, blade, bow or spell. Come and see me when you've gained a level and bring some coin, the lessons aren't free.
pt_vot_forge: I teach mining, where to dig and how to tell ore from plain rock. The camp forge is just north of me by the Farseer's tent, for smelting what you bring back. If you want to learn smithing, that's taught in Razor Hill.
pt_vot_herbs: I teach herbalism, which plants to pick and which to leave alone. If you want to brew them into anything, that's alchemy, and Apothecary Kagra teaches it in Razor Hill.
pt_vot_wood: I teach woodcutting. The camp sawmill is north-west of here, past Marta's fire, for turning logs into planks. If you want to build things with them, Woodwright Hulda teaches that in Razor Hill.
